gloss_en: derekh — 'way/path' (the noun, gematria 224 = 2×112/twice YB"K or twice baki): the mystical 'path in the sea' of the Elul kavanot, identified with marital union (zivug) and the covenant, as in 'all flesh corrupted its way' (Gen 6:12); not any homographic verb form or other root-derivative
